changes: Makes structurally complete All Posts multipart binaries actionable even before a friendly filename is available, with bounded priority name probes and safe generated-name fallback.
Automatically drains loaded unresolved-name work in bounded batches while yielding to package reconstruction and preserving responsive Continuous browsing.
Keeps progressive package reconstruction polling alive with guarded backoff until completion or navigation cancellation instead of abandoning long reconstructions.
Separates resolved, obfuscated-name, no-filename, article-unavailable, and retryable provider outcomes so transient NNTP trouble is never mislabeled as permanent Name Unavailable.
Retries representative multipart segments and applies provider backoff/circuit breaking when name probes encounter transient connection or throttle failures.
Places direct loose Newsgroup binary downloads in the configured Download Folder root without a per-file subfolder, matching direct loose-image behavior.
Preserves opaque yEnc source tokens and detects completed file types when a friendly filename cannot be recovered.
Adds opportunistic exact post-download filename recovery from PAR2 FileDesc metadata using byte length plus full-file MD5, including PAR2-before-payload and payload-before-PAR2 reconciliation.
Adds conservative RAR/ZIP/7-Zip member-name hints without guessing or falsely renaming the outer archive.
regression_guards: Only a PAR2 FileDesc full MD5 plus exact byte-length match may automatically replace an opaque generated filename with a protected original filename.
Archive member names remain hints only and do not rename an outer archive volume without exact metadata proof.
Opaque yEnc source tokens remain safe fallback identities and direct loose downloads continue to land in the configured Download Folder root.
An extensionless yEnc name= value remains OBFUSCATED NAME rather than NO FILENAME or generic NAME UNAVAILABLE.
Transient provider failures remain retryable and are not converted to permanent filename classifications.
Progressive package reconstruction retains priority over automatic filename resolution and long-running polling continues until completion or navigation cancellation.
Grouped binary/NZB packages retain their existing package-directory behavior.
NewzDeck v3.6.20 authoritative SAB Queue/History control and fresh-state reconciliation remain unchanged.
Automation, Smart Import, Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server, Windows service/tray/runtime handoff, installer/updater, and normal NZB collection behavior remain unchanged.
name: All Posts Binary Resolution & Recovery
